title: AI Agents vs Workflows vs Traditional Automation: What Should You Build?
excerpt: A practical framework for choosing deterministic automation, an AI-assisted workflow, or an agent—and knowing when AI should not be used at all.
seoTitle: AI Agents vs Workflows vs Automation: A Decision Guide
seoDescription: Compare AI agents, AI workflows and traditional automation by cost, control, risk and fit. Use a practical framework to choose the simplest reliable design.
author: Anoop Karnik

cover.prompt: Wide 16:9 editorial technology illustration for Bayesian Labs, dark charcoal-black background, three connected systems progressing left to right: a precise mechanical rules engine, a structured glowing workflow graph, and a restrained autonomous agent navigating branching paths, violet and cyan primary light with small emerald verification signals, sophisticated isometric depth, clean negative space, no people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, premium technical magazine aesthetic

cover.caption: Traditional automation, AI-assisted workflows and agents differ primarily in who controls the next step. Conceptual illustration.
